notes: Building and Engineering News, vol. 29 part 2 (Internet Archive buildingengineer29229cont), the 26 weekly issues from 6 July to 28 December 1929. Same method as the earlier volumes: every numbered entry under Building Permit Applications and Building Contracts was taken from the djvu.xml OCR, East Bay headings set aside, and each San Francisco lot built from the block corner on the DPW street centrelines and compared with the sf-parcels shapes; a placement was accepted where the lot starts within two feet of a lot line of today (or the record names an unambiguous corner) and the roll dates the building 1928-1931, and alterations were matched by printed street number in sf-eas-addresses where the roll dates the building before 1929. Every published row was read against the page image, location first; 102 of the 135 rows read needed a name, a cost or the wording corrected, and a cost or name that could not be read on the image was left out. Where a permit and its contract appear in the same issue the page carries one entry and the contract finding is held. Descriptions of rows marked confidence low were built from the OCR and have not been read against the image. Owners are private individuals and are cut everywhere (raw.note); a firm or institution named as owner is kept, and where the contractor or architect named is the owner or shares the owner's surname that name is cut too. Sub-trade contracts are timeline entries and set no builder credit. Completion notices, liens, sub-contracts printed 'on above' and the news columns were not taken. Issue dates come from the cover page of each of the 26 issues, cross-checked with the running heads.

coverage.remaining: Vols. 26, 27, 28 and 29 read (January 1926 to December 1929); the other 26 half-year volumes (1915 to January 1932) are unread, vol. 30 part 1 (January-June 1930, buildingengineer3030cont) next. In this volume: 155 rows placed on a parcel whose roll year fits, all single houses with no architect named and no page, are logged and held until another fact gives the parcel a page (extra.placed_apn; they still need the image check). 271 rows have a nearest parcel that was not accepted (the lot starts off today's lot lines, or the roll dates the building outside the window). 383 rows were not placed: 175 location lines not parsed (tract lots, garbled headings), 98 street pairs that do not cross under the names read (OCR spellings, renamed streets), 108 printed street numbers with no EAS row today and 2 ambiguous.
coverage.note: 1,653 numbered entries read, 944 San Francisco rows, 561 placed on a parcel, 135 picked and read against the page image, 122 published on 118 pages (54 seeded), 13 held back at the image check (same-issue contracts merged into the permit entry, a repeat listing, uses or unit counts that contradict the roll, a misprinted street number, a tract sub-contract).
